features.name: Deferred element realization
features.description: The page initially defers a four-color grid and realizes it when the Realize Elements button is clicked.
expected_behaviour: The explanatory text and Realize Elements button are visible.
Clicking Realize Elements makes the orange, green, blue, and yellow grid visible.

features.name: Adaptive mail panes
features.description: The mail sample realizes its account and reading panes at responsive width thresholds while retaining the mail list.
expected_behaviour: The mail list displays sender, subject, body preview, and received date data.
At wider widths the account list and reading pane become visible.
The reading pane contains Send and Discard buttons, To and CC fields, and an editable message body.

features.name: Deferred template header
features.description: Two TitledImage controls demonstrate that the optional header template part is created only when a header is supplied.
expected_behaviour: The Rainier image displays with its Rainier header.
The valley image displays without an empty header area.
